palp.definition:
n. Same as Palpus.
v. t. To have a distinct touch or feeling of; to feel.
palp.translation:
n. 触须, 须肢
[医] [触]须, 触器(昆虫)

palpability.definition: n the quality of being perceivable by touch
palpability.translation: n. 可感知性, 可感知物

palpable.definition:
a. capable of being perceived; especially capable of being handled or touched or felt
s. can be felt by palpation
palpable.translation:
a. 可感知的, 明显的, 触摸得到的
[医] 可触知的

palpably.definition: r. so as to be palpable
palpably.translation: adv. 摸得出, 可触知, 明显可知, 容易感觉到, 易用感官感知

palpatant.translation: a. 颤抖的, 悸动的

palpate.definition: v. examine (a body part) by palpation
palpate.translation:
vt. 触诊
a. 有触须的

palpated.definition: v examine (a body part) by palpation
palpated.translation: v. 触诊( palpate的过去式和过去分词 )

palpates.definition: v examine (a body part) by palpation
palpates.translation: v. 触诊( palpate的第三人称单数 )

palpating.definition: v examine (a body part) by palpation
palpating.translation: v. 触诊( palpate的现在分词 )

palpation.definition: n. a method of examination in which the examiner feels the size or shape or firmness or location of something (of body parts when the examiner is a health professional)
palpation.translation:
n. 触诊, 扪诊
[医] 触诊, 扪诊

palpatory.definition: a relating to or involving palpation

palpebra.definition: n either of two folds of skin that can be moved to cover or open the eye

palpebral.definition: a. Of or pertaining to the eyelids.
palpebral.translation:
a. 眼睑的
[医] 睑的

palpebral glands.translation: [医] 睑板腺, 迈博姆氏腺

palpebral process.translation: [医] 泪腺睑部, 下泪腺

palpebrate.definition:
v wink or blink, especially repeatedly
a having eyelids

palpebrated.definition: v. wink or blink, especially repeatedly

palpebrates.definition: v. wink or blink, especially repeatedly

palpebrating.definition: v. wink or blink, especially repeatedly

palpebration.definition: n repeated blinking or winking (especially if uncontrolled and persistent)
palpebration.translation: [医] 霎眼, 霎眼过频, 瞬目过多

palpi.definition:
n. pl. of Palpus. (Zool.) See Palpus.
pl.  of Palpus

palpicorn.definition:
n. One of a group of aquatic beetles (Palpicornia) having
   short club-shaped antennae, and long maxillary palpi.

palpiform.definition: a. Having the form of a palpus.

palpiger.definition:
n. That portion of the labium which bears the palpi in
   insects.

palping.definition:
-ing form of palp
n. Same as Palpus.
v. t. To have a distinct touch or feeling of; to feel.
palping.translation:
(palp 的现在分词) n. 触须, 须肢
[医] [触]须, 触器(昆虫)

palpitant.definition: s. having a slight and rapid trembling motion
palpitant.translation: a. 悸动的, 心悸的, 发抖的

palpitate.definition:
v. cause to throb or beat rapidly
v. beat rapidly
palpitate.translation:
vi. 悸动, 心跳, 发抖
[医] 心悸

palpitated.translation: v.  （心脏）悸动( palpitate的过去式和过去分词 ); 突突跳; 急速地跳动; 颤抖

palpitates.definition:
v cause to throb or beat rapidly
v shake with fast, tremulous movements
v beat rapidly
palpitates.translation: v.  （心脏）悸动( palpitate的第三人称单数 ); 突突跳; 急速地跳动; 颤抖

palpitating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Palpitate
palpitating.translation: v.  （心脏）悸动( palpitate的现在分词 ); 突突跳; 急速地跳动; 颤抖

palpitation.definition: n. a rapid and irregular heart beat
palpitation.translation:
n. 悸动, 跳动, 心跳
[医] 心悸, 心跳

palpitations.definition:
n. a rapid and irregular heart beat
n. a shaky motion
palpitations.translation: n. 心悸( palpitation的复数形式 )

palpocil.definition:
n. A minute soft filamentary process springing from the
   surface of certain hydroids and sponges.

palps.definition:
plural of palp
n. Same as Palpus.
v. t. To have a distinct touch or feeling of; to feel.
palps.translation:
(palp 的复数) n. 触须, 须肢
[医] [触]须, 触器(昆虫)

palpus.definition:
n. A feeler; especially, one of the jointed sense organs
   attached to the mouth organs of insects, arachnids, crustaceans, and
   annelids; as, the mandibular palpi, maxillary palpi, and labial palpi.
   The palpi of male spiders serve as sexual organs. Called also palp. See
   Illust. of Arthrogastra and Orthoptera.
